diagnosis.summary: The nightly run for 2026-10-01 (116c53c8) failed at ingest because upstream added a new column, `marketing_opt_in`, to customers.csv. That column isn't in the raw.customers contract. All 5 contract columns are still there and unchanged, and the row count is normal. I've proposed telling ingest to ignore this one extra column on customers, as the schema-change runbook says to do. It hasn't been applied yet: the harness will apply it and rerun the pipeline to verify.

root_cause.explanation: Starting 2026-10-01, upstream added a column called marketing_opt_in (true/false) to the end of customers.csv. The ingest contract check rejects any column it doesn't expect, so ingest failed. Nothing is missing, so this isn't a rename. The 5 contract columns, their formats and the row count (30) all match 2026-09-30.

evidence.claim: Run 116c53c8 failed at the ingest step because of a schema mismatch on raw.customers: no missing columns, one unexpected column marketing_opt_in.
The 10-01 customers.csv has the 5 contract columns plus a new marketing_opt_in column at the end. The 09-30 file had only the contract columns. Formats and row count (30) are unchanged.
On 10-01 the orders, order_items and payments files match their contracts, so customers is the only table with a schema change.
The ingest config has no custom settings, so nothing already handles the new column.
The runbook says: an unexpected column with nothing missing is a new upstream column. The fix is ignore_extra_columns, followed by a rerun.

alternatives_considered: Column renamed (apply_column_mapping): ruled out because no contract column is missing.
Asking upstream to redeliver: rejected because the new column looks like a deliberate upstream change, not a one-off bad file, so the runbook says to adapt ingest.
Escalating to upstream_app_team: not needed because the column doesn't replace a dropped column or change what any metric means.
Bad dbt model deploy: ruled out because the failure happens at ingest, before any dbt step runs.
Just rerunning: rejected because a rerun would fail the same way on the same schema mismatch.

proposal.rationale: Upstream added a new non-contract column marketing_opt_in to customers.csv on 2026-10-01. All 5 contract columns are still present and unchanged, and row counts are normal. The runbook says to adapt ingest by ignoring the extra column and then rerun the partition.

applied: ingest now ignores upstream columns ['marketing_opt_in'] on raw.customers
